LESSON: ETIQUETTE OF ISLAMIC WEDDING CELEBRATIONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is the Islamic etiquette that guides wedding celebrations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on a wedding celebration they have attended and note down

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on a wedding celebration they have attended and note down

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: as learners brainstorm on a wedding celebration they have attended and note down what

they observed/experienced.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners role-play the etiquette to be observed during the

celebration.

Values:
Respect as learners brainstorm on a wedding celebration they have attended and note down what they observed/experienced.
